svg.title: Diagram of a sale moving from this device, optionally through a nearby relay, to the cloud and then the payment provider, with the five states Queued, Sent, Accepted, Confirmed and Failed, each with an icon, a label and a short meaning.

svg.text: How a sale moves, and what each state means

svg.text: A relayed sale stays “sent” until the cloud accepts it. LynkOmni never holds the money.
